consent.analytics.body: Can we count how the app is used, and get a report when something breaks? We record page addresses, actions and error details — never your record contents. You can change this any time in Settings.
consent.analytics.google: This also turns on Google Analytics, which sets cookies and sends data about your visit to Google.
consent.analytics.label: Analytics consent
consent.analytics.signalled: Your browser is set to Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control, so analytics stays off. We do not override that.
home.compare.asOf: Competitor details as of {date}. Source: each vendor's public pricing page.
home.migratecalc.asOf: Their figures are list prices for annual billing, as of {date}. Source: each vendor's public pricing page.
home.migratecalc.billed: {count} seats billed — Appdor charges per editor, so you stop paying for seats nobody uses.
home.migratecalc.noSaving: No saving is shown: the two prices are in different currencies, and we do not convert between them.
